storySection.title: Crafting Luxury Through Digital Precision
paragraphs: Kohler has established a brand synonymous with timeless luxury and innovation. Their offerings are more than just bathroom fixtures — they are masterpieces of engineering and design excellence.

The challenge was to visually communicate this craftsmanship without the logistical complexity and expense of high-end photoshoots. Kohler needed an intelligent, scalable solution to replicate the realism of photography using CGI, while maintaining luxury standards.
That’s where Prakria’s advanced 3D modeling, 3D animation, and CGI expertise came into play — blending art and technology to create visuals that embodied Kohler’s brand philosophy.

challenge.title: THE CHALLENGE
challenge.description: As the world leader in luxury bathroom and kitchen products, Kohler had an opportunity to raise the bar for the way its product was presented—by articulating the essence of its products through next-generation, digital-first visuals that were on par with its design excellence.

list.text: Craftsmanship is the foundation of Kohler products: every curve, cut, finish and reflection matters. The images of these high-end kitchen and bath fixtures had to reflect that perfection.
Traditional photography and physical shoots were becoming too time-intensive, costly and logistically complex to meet the pace and variety of Kohler’s global portfolio.

The brand required high-impact, hyper-realistic 3D renders and CGI that captured the luxury essence of the products — with impeccable attention to detail, accurate materials, lighting and reflections.
At the same time, these visual assets had to be delivered quickly, work across multiple global markets, and remain consistent with Kohler’s premium identity.
In short, the challenge was to translate Kohler’s exceptional product quality into equally exceptional digital visuals — fast, flawless and true to the brand’s premium positioning.

list.title: Our Approach - From Design DNA to Digital Art
list.description: We aimed to translate Kohler’s design excellence into the digital world, capturing not just the products, but the stories behind their craftsmanship.

list.title: Creative Concept
list.description: By studying each piece — its gold finishes, reflections, and surfaces — we set out to recreate them as digital masterpieces, preserving every nuance of light and form.

list.title: Design Execution
list.description: Through photorealistic 3D modeling, we built exact digital twins of each product. Every reflection, curve, and texture was rendered with precision, achieving realism that blurred the line between virtual and real. Next, 3D animation brought these creations to life — faucets gliding, water flowing, and details unfolding with cinematic grace.

list.title: Outcome
list.description: The result was digital storytelling through movement — transforming product visualization into an immersive art form that elevated Kohler’s innovation and design legacy.

executionSection.title: THE CREATIVE EXECUTION
executionSection.description:
To make the visuals even more immersive, we layered subtle VFX animation — like the sparkle of light on chrome or a gentle glint suggesting premium craftsmanship. These touches lent a cinematic feel to the renders. For explanatory overlays and annotations, we incorporated 2D animation alongside engaging 3D scenes. The marriage of 2D and 3D animation allowed us to produce videos, interactive presentations, and promotional materials that complemented other platforms. By blending the two techniques, our visuals gained both style and clarity.

Initially, our assignment was to create assets for the Indian market. But as Kohler’s global teams saw the quality, they began commissioning additional projects. What began as a single collaboration soon evolved into a long-term, worldwide partnership. We delivered a diverse array of outputs:

list.title: High-Quality Renders
list.description: Photorealistic images for marketing, print, and advertising.

list.title: Animated Product Films
list.description: Short cinematic videos highlighting product features and innovation.

list.title: Interactive 3D Previews
list.description: Immersive previews for presentations, trade shows, and customer engagement.

list.title: Modular 3D Assets
list.description: Flexible 3D files that international teams could customize for varied campaigns.

resultSection.title: THE RESULT
resultSection.description: The results were immediate and powerful:

list.text: Kohler gained full creative control over lighting, angles, and materials — something traditional photography couldn’t match.
The brand was thus able to speed up the time that they had their campaigns, which had a great impact on their assets’ allocation.
The images created were very close to customers' reality, hence most people could not figure out that they were the 3D renderings.
The marketing departments of Kohler across the globe were given the chance to not only re-use but also to re-design the products without spending time or money.

Above all, these pictures contributed significantly to the preservation of the prestigious market position of Kohler. The use of top-class animation and photoreal 3D design gave them the opportunity not only to show their products but also to facilitate the products' high-level experience.

whySection.title: WHY THIS MATTERS
whySection.description: This project shows how animation and 3D modeling aren’t just tools for entertainment — they’re strategic branding instruments. For premium products, visual storytelling matters as much as the product itself.

list.text: With the right animation studio, brands can bypass logistical barriers, shorten timelines, and still deliver visuals that feel luxurious and alive.
By combining 3D animation, 2D animation, and vfx animation, companies can create assets that work everywhere, from digital ads to showroom displays.

The goal was to create a key visual so mouth-watering that people could almost taste the product through the screen. However, traditional food photography came with challenges like melting textures, complex setups, and long production cycles.

storySection.title: Visualising Purity Through Digital Craft
paragraphs: Imperial Blue wanted to create visuals that captured the essence of purity — crystal-clear, refreshing, and premium. However, water is notoriously difficult to capture with photography. Its behavior, reflections, and lighting are unpredictable and costly to control.
The brand needed a smarter, more adaptable solution — one that could digitally replicate the flow and luminosity of water with complete precision.
That’s where Prakria came in, combining 3D design, 3D modeling, and VFX animation to build photorealistic water assets that were consistent, scalable, and artistically captivating.

list.text: The brand's product images had to be of a high level of clarity, realism and polish, especially as 3D/CGI would be used rather than traditional photography.
There were multiple angles, finishes and lighting setups and although the production was to be high quality the process had to be simplistic enough to handle quantity.
The assets needed to work across diverse formats (online, print, packaging, POS) while retaining brand identity and premium feel.
A consistent “hero” visual standard had to be maintained even as new variants or creative executions were rolled out.

VFX animation added realism with subtle glints, micro-particles, and flares, while 2D overlays highlighted branding cues and explanatory details seamlessly.

list.title: Outcome

storySection.title: Digital Realism for Nature’s Complexity
paragraphs: Few things are as challenging as capturing the natural juiciness, surface detail, and vibrancy of fruits and nuts. Each element — texture, translucency, reflection — must feel authentic and harmonious to recreate nature’s complexity.
Prakria was hired to elevate existing product photography into a sensory digital feast. The goal was to make viewers feel the crunch, the creaminess, the juiciness — without ever shooting real food.

Because physical shoots come with issues like perishability, lighting inconsistency, and setup limitations, Prakria proposed a complete 3D route — building the entire visual world through digital craft.

challenge.title: THE CHALLENGE
challenge.description: Food photography is notoriously challenging: It’s not just about color or shape but about expressing texture, flavor and even emotion. For Fruits and Nuts 3D, Prakria aimed to represent the bounty of the natural world wholly in the digital space.

list.text: The real challenge was to represent the natural realism of fruits and nuts; their shine, crispiness, juiciness and translucency, without any single real photo.

There were limitations to shooting traditional food photography: Deterioration, uneven lighting and moving parts. We had to get back that same sensory depth, that same authentic feel, but with nothing but 3D modeling and animation.
From a juice droplet to the texture of a nut shell, everything is believably tactile and mouth-watering, scientific and emotionally warm.
The brief was to create a single visual identity that spanned the gamut of print, digital, motion and interactive media and could be applied from front to back.
But it was never just about technical accuracy; it was about crafting digital assets into sensory storytelling where the viewer could almost taste the images.

startageySection.title: THE STRATEGY
startageySection.description: We did 3D modeling, design, animation, and VFX animation to build a whole new environment in 3D.

list.title: 3D Modeling
list.description: We created fruits, nuts, shells, kernels, leaves, and juice drops in 3D, achieving such fidelity that we could virtually photograph their textures—the tiny ridges, the translucency, and the irregularities that make them lifelike.

list.title: 3D Design
list.description: The designs conveyed a sense of perpetual movement—fruits and elements repeating, intertwining, and layering. Using scale, light, and negative space, we let the visuals breathe and feel as if they were still in motion.

list.title: 3D Animation
list.description: We animated fruits rolling, nuts cracking, and juice droplets splashing, ensuring every routine movement felt luxurious, tactile, and deep.

list.title: VFX Animation
list.description: Carefully layered soft effects—like mist, micro droplets, and subtle light flares—were added to give life and drama, elevating the flat stills to a new level of narrative plastic art.

list.title: 2D Animation Enhancements
list.description: In select versions, we introduced elegant overlays and animated callouts for nutritional highlights or descriptive labels—blending flat graphic motion with the richness of the 3D visuals.

executionSection.title: THE CREATIVE EXECUTION
executionSection.description: Once the core visuals were perfected, Prakria extended them into a complete, cross-format 3D asset library adaptable across media and campaigns.

list.title: High-Definition Print & Packaging Renders
list.description: High-definition still renders for print, packaging, e-commerce, and OOH applications. Visuals optimized for both large-scale billboards and precise pack layouts.

list.title: Cinematic 3D Animation
list.description: Cinematic 3D animation clips created for digital campaigns, launch teasers, and product reveal videos.

list.title: Looping Animations for Digital Displays
list.description: Looping animations tailored for retail display screens, social banners, web headers, and digital signage.

list.title: Variant Scenes & Flavors
list.description: Multiple variant CGI scenes matching different flavor combinations (e.g. almond & berry, cashew & mango), allowing visual flexibility and campaign-specific assets.

list.title: Interactive UI/UX & 3D Previews
list.description: UI/UX application previews, including interactive 3D product views for websites and kiosk experiences.

resultSection.title: THE RESULT
resultSection.description: The product was given a high-end, fresh, appetizing feel by these images, which helped it stand apart from the many products available in grocery and online listings.
